skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm Skye, the assistant for Moxey Remodeling. Planning a new bathroom, a kitchen update or some tile work? Tell me about it and I'll help you get an estimate or book a time.

about.headline: You enjoy your home. We handle the remodeling work properly.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same things from a remodel: a clear price before anything starts, a layout that suits how they live, and tile and trim finished so it looks right for years. Every job is planned around that, from the first measure to the last grout line.

cards.title: Dated bathrooms
cards.body: A full bathroom renovation with a layout and finishes chosen for how you use the room.

cards.title: Kitchens that need a refresh
cards.body: New surfaces, tile and finishes, or a full remodel when the layout isn't working.

cards.title: Floors and finishing
cards.body: Tile floors, trim and detailed finishing that pull the rest of the house together.

about.closing: Not sure where to start? Tell us about the room and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Finding a reliable remodeler in Ocala shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow estimates
points.body: You leave messages, wait a week, and still don't have a number to plan around.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A one-line quote that grows once the old tile is up and the walls are open.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Start dates slip and the bathroom stays out of action longer than anyone said.

points.title: Sloppy finishing
points.body: Uneven tile, wide grout lines and trim that's never quite finished.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a clear estimate.

solutions.headline: Straightforward remodeling built around clear communication.

services.title: Bathroom renovations
services.body: Full bathroom renovations with custom layouts and finishes, from the shower and vanity to the floor tile.

services.title: Kitchen remodels
services.body: Kitchen remodels and surface upgrades: new countertops, backsplash tile and finishes, or a full rework.

services.title: Tile, flooring and trim
services.body: Tile installation for kitchens, bathrooms and floors, plus flooring, trim work and detailed finishing.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Estimate it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your estimate
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give us a call. A ZIP code and a rough idea of the room is plenty.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We measure up, talk through layout and finishes, and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Clean, on-time work
steps.body: A start date you can plan around, with the work area protected and cleaned up each day.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished room with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to do it properly.

themes.title: Kitchen & bath focused
themes.body: Bathrooms, kitchens and tile are the work, not a side line.

themes.title: Written estimates
themes.body: Scope and price in writing, so you can compare it side by side.

themes.title: Detail in the finish
themes.body: Straight tile lines, clean grout and trim finished properly.

themes.title: Direct communication
themes.body: One point of contact who answers your questions as the job goes.

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your kitchen or bathroom?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.

faq.a: Send the project through the form or give us a call. We'll ask a few questions, come out to measure if the job needs it, and send a written estimate that lists the scope and price.

faq.q: Which areas around Ocala do you cover?
faq.a: Ocala and Marion County, including Silver Springs, Belleview and Summerfield, down to The Villages. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: How soon can you look at my project?
faq.a: You get a confirmation as soon as you send a request, and we reply to set up a time. If you'd rather book directly, pick a slot in the calendar.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the project and book a site visit if it needs one.
